procedure.method: Independent review in this fresh conversation. I verified the explicitly supplied file hashes and byte counts and read the pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, ratio policy, helper source files and five native-evidence manifests without opening their unlisted embedded paths. The packet declares no source_assets or protected_layouts, so their procedure arrays are empty. I used five functions.exec viewing batches in packet order M1, M2, M3, M4, M5. Each batch awaited three tools.view_image calls in native, usage720, thumbnail320 order with detail:'original', and emitted each returned image using image(...,'original'), for fifteen actual image-view calls. I visually inspected all fifteen returned images before retaining the first transcription readings, assigning any image scores or judging set diversity. No revisit was used. PNG headers independently verified native dimensions and RGB color type 2 without tRNS; no image was resized or edited by me. The runner's session/thread identity is not observable to me and is left null; no trace-derived assertion is made.
